experiment: Slab synthetic dataset (2-D, 7 slabs, slab noise 0.1), 3-layer MLP; source domains = linear-component noise 0.0 and 0.1, target = noise 1.0
notes: Repo has no dedicated Table 1 command beyond reproduce_scripts/reproduce_slab.py (train then evaluate); data comes from data_gen_syn.py.

Target domain 1.0 is requested (--test_domains 1.0) but data_gen_syn.py only generates spur_corr in [0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.9]; the pickle for spur_corr 1.0 is never produced, so the target-domain load would fail with FileNotFoundError unless the data is generated otherwise.
slab_data.py hard-codes the data directory '/home/t-dimaha/RobustDG/robustdg/data/datasets/slab/' whereas data_gen_syn.py writes to 'data/datasets/slab/'; paths must be reconciled.
--slab_num_samples is not passed, default 1000: only the first 1000 of the generated 10000 train/test examples and first 250 of val are used per domain.

Source accuracies (Source 1, Source 2) come from `test.py --test_metric per_domain_acc --acc_data_case train` on the stored best-val checkpoint, reported as mean and standard ERROR (std/sqrt(n)) over 10 seeds. Target accuracy comes from train.py printed 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)': mean and np.std (standard deviation) over runs. The spreads differ in kind between columns.

Checkpoint selection reads source validation accuracy (train domains, val split) with strict '>' ; the train.py printed value 'Target Validation' (max of test acc over epochs) is an oracle, not the one used for 'Source Validation'.
The per-epoch test accuracy (target domain) is computed every epoch but only used for reporting/oracle, not for saving the checkpoint.

BaseAlgo creates StepLR(step_size=25) but scheduler.step() is never called anywhere in algorithms/, so LR is effectively constant. DANN does not use self.opt at all; it uses two SGD optimizers lr 0.01, no momentum, wd 5e-4 (so base lr 0.1 does not apply).
Optimizer for ERM/MMD/CORAL/RandMatch/PerfMatch: SGD lr 0.1, momentum 0.9, nesterov True, weight_decay default 5e-4 (not overridden by script; the 5e-5 in data_gen_syn config is unused).
train.py's --dataset is an argparse prefix abbreviation of --dataset_name.
DANN alternates by epoch (epoch % (1+d_steps) < d_steps => discriminator-only epochs, else generator step), not by batch. Generator loss = CE - lambda*disc_loss.

Hyperparameter tuning (slab-tune.py) uses 3 seeds, reads 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)' line (data[-4]) mean from train.py logs, i.e. test-domain accuracy at the source-val-selected epoch (target domain 1.0 data) — target-domain data influences hyperparameter choice. Grid: penalty {0.1,1,10} (mmd/coral/c-*/rand/perf), DANN penalty {0.01..100}, grad_penalty {0.01,0.1,1,10}, d_steps {1,2,4,8}. Note: line data[-4] is the 'Source Validation' line given trailing prints. The reproduce script's final values: mmd/coral/c-* penalty_ws 0.1; dann 0.01/grad 0.1/d_steps 4; c-dann 0.01/grad 1.0/d_steps 2; rand/perf 1.0.

Method mapping: ERM=erm_match penalty_ws 0; RandMatch=erm_match match_case 0.0 penalty_ws 1.0; PerfMatch=match_case 1.0 penalty_ws 1.0; MMD=mmd gaussian 1 cond 0; CORAL=mmd gaussian 0 cond 0; C-MMD / C-CORAL conditional 1; DANN / C-DANN via dann.
Training for each domain has noisy label? No: domains differ in the probability (spur_corr) of corrupting the linear feature; slab noise 0.1 is applied equally to all domains (including the target).
Methods ERM-match based: for ERM, loss is CE on a matched batch (data_matched via random match) with penalty weight 0 (so only CE). Train accuracy during training for ERM-match uses matched batches.
